public class VkDisplaySurfaceCreateInfoKHR extends Struct<VkDisplaySurfaceCreateInfoKHR> implements NativeResource
struct VkDisplaySurfaceCreateInfoKHR {
    VkStructureType sType;
    void const * pNext;

    uint32_t planeStackIndex;

}
